summary: This House resolution expresses support for designating October 26, 2025, as "Day of the Deployed" to honor deployed U.S. Armed Forces members and their families, and encourages public observance of this day.

scores.thoughts: This resolution is purely commemorative, supporting the designation of a 'Day of the Deployed' to honor service members. It does not propose any changes to military spending, either increasing or decreasing it.
The bill is a commemorative resolution honoring deployed service members and does not address foreign aid in any capacity. It focuses solely on recognizing military personnel.
